```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4,fig.width=9, out.width="70%"}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Load data
d_prime_poll_interactions <- readr::read_csv("../../Data/Working_files/average_d_prime_by_week_corrected_by_int.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Botanical_garden, Week, av_dprime_poll, 
                av_dprime_poll_upper, av_dprime_poll_lower) %>%
  rename(av_dprime_poll_int = av_dprime_poll, 
         av_dprime_poll_int_upper = av_dprime_poll_upper, 
         av_dprime_poll_int_lower = av_dprime_poll_lower)

d_prime_poll_abundance <- readr::read_csv("../../Data/Working_files/average_d_prime_by_week_corrected_by_ab.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Botanical_garden, Week, av_dprime_poll, 
                av_dprime_poll_upper, av_dprime_poll_lower) %>%
  rename(av_dprime_poll_ab = av_dprime_poll, 
         av_dprime_poll_ab_upper = av_dprime_poll_upper, 
         av_dprime_poll_ab_lower = av_dprime_poll_lower)

average_specialization <- d_prime_poll_interactions %>%
  left_join(d_prime_poll_abundance, by = c("Botanical_garden","Week"))

average_specialization_SEASON_int <- readr::read_csv("../../Data/Working_files/average_d_prime_by_SEASON_corrected_by_int.csv")
average_specialization_SEASON_ab <- readr::read_csv("../../Data/Working_files/average_d_prime_by_SEASON_corrected_by_ab.csv")

# First plot

average_specialization$Botanical_garden = factor(average_specialization$Botanical_garden,
                                                 levels = c("Halle", "Leipzig", "Jena"))

plot_av_dprime_poll_interactions <- ggplot(average_specialization, aes(x=Week, y=av_dprime_poll_int, color=Botanical_garden)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#440154FF", "#2A788EFF", "#7AD151FF")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=average_specialization_SEASON_int$av_dprime_poll[average_specialization_SEASON_int$Botanical_garden=="Jena"],
             linewidth=1.5, color="#2A788EFF", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=average_specialization_SEASON_int$av_dprime_poll[average_specialization_SEASON_int$Botanical_garden=="Halle"],
             linewidth=1.5, color="#440154FF", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=average_specialization_SEASON_int$av_dprime_poll[average_specialization_SEASON_int$Botanical_garden=="Leipzig"],
             linewidth=1.5, color="#7AD151FF", linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x="Week number", y=" ", title=NULL, color=NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_text(size=18),
        axis.text=element_text(size=16),
        axis.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        plot.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        strip.text=element_text(size=18),
         panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=2)) +
  guides(fill="none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0, 0.5, 1), limits=c(0, 1), expand=expansion(mult=c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(15, 25, 35), limits=c(12, 35))

# Second plot
plot_av_dprime_poll_abundance <- ggplot(average_specialization, aes(x=Week, y=av_dprime_poll_ab, color=Botanical_garden)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#440154FF", "#2A788EFF", "#7AD151FF")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=average_specialization_SEASON_ab$av_dprime_poll[average_specialization_SEASON_ab$Botanical_garden=="Jena"],
             linewidth=1.5, color="#2A788EFF", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=average_specialization_SEASON_ab$av_dprime_poll[average_specialization_SEASON_ab$Botanical_garden=="Halle"],
             linewidth=1.5, color="#440154FF", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=average_specialization_SEASON_ab$av_dprime_poll[average_specialization_SEASON_ab$Botanical_garden=="Leipzig"],
             linewidth=1.5, color="#7AD151FF", linetype="dotted") +
  labs(x="Week number", y="  \n  ", title=NULL, color=NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_text(size=18),
        axis.text=element_text(size=16),
        axis.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        plot.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        strip.text=element_text(size=18),
         panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=2)) +
  guides(fill="none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0, 0.5, 1), limits=c(0, 1), expand=expansion(mult=c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(15, 25, 35), limits=c(12, 35))

# Combine plots with a single legend
combined_plot <- (plot_av_dprime_poll_interactions | plot_av_dprime_poll_abundance) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')

print(combined_plot)

# Save the plot as a high-quality PNG
ggsave("question1.png", plot = combined_plot, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 500)



```
